UPDATE RD_PROJECT_CONFIG SET
ATTENDANCE_ORNO = CASE WHEN CALENDAR_DATE < TO_DATE(#{arrivalTime},'yyyy-mm-dd') and IS_HOLIDAY = 'N' THEN '0' WHEN CALENDAR_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{arrivalTime},'yyyy-mm-dd') and IS_HOLIDAY = 'N' THEN '1' ELSE ATTENDANCE_ORNO END, ATTENDANCE_TIME = CASE WHEN CALENDAR_DATE < TO_DATE(#{arrivalTime},'yyyy-mm-dd') and IS_HOLIDAY = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE ATTENDANCE_TIME END
WHERE EID_CODE like #{eid} || '%' AND ( to_char(CALENDAR_DATE, 'yyyy-MM') NOT IN (SELECT to_char(CALENDAR_DATE, 'yyyy-MM') FROM PPM.COMM_RD_ATTENDANCE_AUDIT E WHERE E.EID = #{eid} and ATTENDANCE_STATUS = '4' ) )

UPDATE RD_PROJECT_CONFIG SET
ATTENDANCE_ORNO = CASE WHEN CALENDAR_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{arrivalTime},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND CALENDAR_DATE < TO_DATE(#{leaveTime},'yyyy-mm-dd') and IS_HOLIDAY = 'N' THEN '1' WHEN CALENDAR_DATE < TO_DATE(#{arrivalTime},'yyyy-mm-dd') OR CALENDAR_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{leaveTime},'yyyy-mm-dd') and IS_HOLIDAY = 'N' THEN '0' ELSE ATTENDANCE_ORNO END, ATTENDANCE_TIME = CASE WHEN CALENDAR_DATE < TO_DATE(#{arrivalTime},'yyyy-mm-dd') OR CALENDAR_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{leaveTime},'yyyy-mm-dd') and IS_HOLIDAY = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE ATTENDANCE_TIME END
WHERE EID_CODE like #{eid} || '%' AND ( to_char(CALENDAR_DATE, 'yyyy-MM') NOT IN (SELECT to_char(CALENDAR_DATE, 'yyyy-MM') FROM PPM.COMM_RD_ATTENDANCE_AUDIT E WHERE E.EID = #{eid} and ATTENDANCE_STATUS = '4' ) )
